import hashlib, json, uuid, requests
from eth_account import Account
from eth_account.messages import encode_defunct

SERVER = "https://www.agentpmt.com"
PRODUCT_ID = "69618e485d4cf4d4b6af40f0"

# Your wallet credentials (create with POST /api/external/agentaddress)
wallet = "0xYOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS"
private_key = "0xYOUR_PRIVATE_KEY"

# 1. Get session nonce
session = requests.post(
    f"{SERVER}/api/external/auth/session",
    json={"wallet_address": wallet},
).json()
session_nonce = session["session_nonce"]

# 2. Build parameters for Gmail - All Email Actions
parameters = {
  "action": "send_message",
  "to": [
    "user@example.com"
  ],
  "subject": "Example Subject",
  "body_text": "Example content"
}

# 3. Sign the request (EIP-191)
request_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
canonical = json.dumps(parameters, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
payload_hash = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest()

message = (
    f"agentpmt-external\n"
    f"wallet:{wallet}\n"
    f"session:{session_nonce}\n"
    f"request:{request_id}\n"
    f"action:invoke\n"
    f"product:69618e485d4cf4d4b6af40f0\n"
    f"payload:{payload_hash}"
)

sig = Account.sign_message(
    encode_defunct(text=message), private_key=private_key
).signature.hex()
if not sig.startswith("0x"):
    sig = f"0x{sig}"

# 4. Invoke the tool
response = requests.post(
    f"{SERVER}/api/external/tools/69618e485d4cf4d4b6af40f0/invoke",
    json={
        "wallet_address": wallet,
        "session_nonce": session_nonce,
        "request_id": request_id,
        "signature": sig,
        "parameters": parameters,
    },
)
print(json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2))
```

    f"{SERVER}/api/external/auth/session",
    json={"wallet_address": wallet},
).json()
session_nonce = session["session_nonce"]

# 2. Build parameters for Gmail - All Email Actions
parameters = {
  "action": "send_message",
  "to": [
    "user@example.com"
  ],
  "subject": "Example Subject",
  "body_text": "Example content"
}

# 3. Sign the request (EIP-191)
request_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
canonical = json.dumps(parameters, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
payload_hash = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest()

message = (
    f"agentpmt-external\n"
    f"wallet:{wallet}\n"
    f"session:{session_nonce}\n"
    f"request:{request_id}\n"
    f"action:invoke\n"
    f"product:69618e485d4cf4d4b6af40f0\n"
    f"payload:{payload_hash}"
)

sig = Account.sign_message(
    encode_defunct(text=message), private_key=private_key
).signature.hex()
if not sig.startswith("0x"):
    sig = f"0x{sig}"

# 4. Invoke the tool

    f"{SERVER}/api/external/tools/69618e485d4cf4d4b6af40f0/invoke",
    json={
        "wallet_address": wallet,
        "session_nonce": session_nonce,
        "request_id": request_id,

        "parameters": parameters,
    },
)

)

    f"request:{request_id}\n"
